dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_main_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes the specified packages with their latest stable versions as of the knowledge cutoff. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image for a lightweight container, sets up the working directory, installs the dependencies, copies the application code, and sets the default command to run the main script. Replace 'your_main_script.py' with the actual entry point of your application.
